text:
anna: Heads-up 97 vendor-jp flagged 10 H100s (batch 24-02) with possible thermal sensor drift at FRA depot. Need decision: depot repair vs return-to-vendor (R2V).
rahul: Any AWB/manifest + photos? Timeline if depot repair?
vendor-jp: AWB 4987123001. Arrived FRA-DEPOT-4. Photos uploaded. Depot repair ETA 2-4d; R2V transit ~5-7d.
ops-bot: [AWB 4987123001] ARRIVED FRA-DEPOT-4 2024-11-05 09:02 UTC.
finance-bot: Quick cost sketch: R2V courier ~€1,100 + customs admin €120. Depot bench ~€200/unit + handling €250.
lena: Operational constraint 97 FRA dock slots tight after 11/07. If depot, we must confirm slot by EOD today. Crossdock to AMS adds extra handling.
vendor-jp: We can waive bench fee for up to 6 units as a warranty gesture; rest billed. Replacements under warranty no charge. We'll email formal amendment to procurement.
rahul: With waiver, depot cost approx = 4*200 + 250 = €1,050 vs R2V €1,220. Depot seems preferred if waiver confirmed.
anna: Action: vendor-jp send amendment to procurement@redwood.internal by 16:30 CET. Ops to tentatively hold dock until 16:30 CET. Finance to post expected-value calc by 16:15 CET.
ops-bot: Reminder: dock hold expires 2024-11-05 16:30 CET unless amendment received.
anna: Also request serial list now for warranty trace. vendor-jp: serials shared on secure link.
anna: Thanks all 97 proceeding to hold for depot pending written waiver.
